title: Preview selected fields in an authorized supplier reconciliation aging report
description: Purchasing user selects finite invoice evidence fields and existing filters for a bounded dynamic preview. Development only; reuse existing SupplierReconciliationAging.ForQueryAsync evidence, current-user purchase-order menu authorization and HTTP audit. Preserve explicit due-date unknowns, separate currencies, draft/void history and invalid/unknown allocation evidence. Fail closed on missing permission, invalid requests or source failures. No payment approval, ledger inference, arbitrary SQL, migration, production SQL, real database execution, business writes, secrets/.env or deployment. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test; no browser acceptance.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog and preview allow only finite invoice evidence fields in selected order and validate existing supplier/currency/status/date/as-of filters and page size at most 200 before source reads.
Preview rechecks current-user purchase-order menu and projects only selected columns from SupplierReconciliationAging.ForQueryAsync current page, retaining separate currencies and unknown evidence.
Tests cover authorized and denied users, invalid fields/filters, selected order, currency/unknown evidence, bounded paging and no writes; document limits.
